title: Chicken Lamp
description: A simple mod adding chicken lamp to minecraft.
body:
# Chicken Lamp

## Overview
The **Chicken Lamp** mod is a delightful addition to your Minecraft world, bringing the charm of homely lighting with a twist of the unexpected.

### Features
- **Homely Illumination**: Transform your chicken coops into cozy lighting sources.
- **Craftable Items**: Create unique lamps using chicken drops.
- **Easy Integration**: Seamlessly integrates with your existing Minecraft world.

### Version
- **Minecraft Version**: 1.20 Forge (will support more versions in the future)
- **Mod Version**: Use RELEASE version. The BETA version have some problem with the model.

## How

### Crafting Recipes
- **Chicken Lamp**: Put a torch on the middle of the crafting table, then put raw chicken, cooked chicken, feather or egg around it.
